transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... hi. Well, I guess... I'm here because I just can't seem to stop focusing on this... this spot. Right around my jaw and my neck. 

It's just sagging and... uneven. Folks try to tell me it looks normal, but... I don't know. I just feel like whether I'm at work with the nurses and the families, or just sitting at church... it's the very first thing people notice when they look at me. So... yeah. I guess that's why I came in.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, especially because of how you see your appearance?
I don't... I wouldn't say I'm sad. Not really. I mean, I still do the things I need to do. I haven't lost interest or anything like that. It just... bothers me, is all.
How much time do you find yourself thinking about the way your jaw and neck look in a typical day?

I don't know... I guess a fair amount. It's hard to put an exact number on it. I just... I think about it when I'm getting ready for the day, mostly. And maybe sometimes when I catch a reflection. But I don't really time it.
Does worrying about the way your jaw and neck look interfere with your daily life, such as making it hard to focus, causing you to avoid certain situations, or affecting how you interact with others?

I guess... maybe a little. I mean, at work, I've kind of... stepped back from some things. Like, I don't really want to lead any of the meetings or do the supervisory stuff anymore. I just... I don't like the idea of everyone staring at me, at my face. And sometimes the paperwork piles up because it takes me so long to get ready in the morning, trying to... fix things. 

And outside of work... I don't know, I've skipped some book club meetings. And the walking group. Sometimes just the thought of having to get ready and go out where people can see me... it just feels like too much effort. So I just stay home.
Have you noticed any physical changes in your jaw or neck area, such as swelling, skin changes, or pain, that might be causing you to focus on it more?
No... I don't think so. There's no pain or swelling or anything like that. It doesn't hurt. It just... looks the way it does.
Do you find yourself repeatedly checking your jaw and neck in mirrors, avoiding mirrors altogether, or doing anything else to try to hide or fix how it looks?

I guess I do check it. Before I leave for work... I just keep going back to the bathroom mirror. I try to fix my collar, pull my hair around my neck... just to see if it helps. Sometimes I use my phone camera to check it again. I've asked my daughter if it looks weird, but... I don't know. Doing all that, it's made me late a few times.
Do these concerns about your jaw and neck ever make it hard for you to be around other people, or cause you a lot of distress even when you're alone?
I mean... I guess it does. I don't really like being around a lot of people right now. And even when I'm just by myself... it still bothers me. I just think about it a lot.
